```{r ari-pd-vs-fpdc}
required_packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "mclust")
installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(mclust)
```

```{r settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_to_compare <- c(2, 3, 4, 5)   # FPDC was only cached for k = 2:5
q_range <- 2:4                  # FPDC q-range from your code

dir.create("output/pd_fpdc_ari_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load cached PD result for one embedding and k
load_cached_pd_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val,
                                 cache_dir = "output/pd_cache") {
  
  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
  )
  
  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  readRDS(cache_file)
}

# Load best cached FPDC result for one embedding and k
# By default: choose highest Silhouette, then CH as tiebreaker
load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:4,
                                        cache_dir = "output/fpdc_cache") {
  
  candidates <- list()
  
  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      cache_dir,
      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
      
      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        k = k_val,
        q = q_val,
        model = cached$model,
        silhouette = cached$Silhouette,
        ch = cached$CH,
        prob_silh = cached$ProbSilh,
        file = cache_file
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  candidate_df <- bind_rows(lapply(candidates, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      q = x$q,
      Silhouette = x$silhouette,
      CH = x$ch,
      ProbSilh = x$prob_silh
    )
  }))
  
  best_idx <- with(candidate_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
  candidates[[best_idx]]
}
```

```{r main}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN LOOP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ari_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {
  
  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing embedding file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_tag, "\n")
  
  for (k_val in k_to_compare) {
    cat("  Comparing PD vs FPDC for k =", k_val, "\n")
    
    # ----------------------------
    # Load PD
    # ----------------------------
    pd_cached <- load_cached_pd_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val = k_val,
      cache_dir = "output/pd_cache"
    )
    
    if (is.null(pd_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing PD cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # ----------------------------
    # Load best FPDC for same k
    # ----------------------------
    fpdc_cached <- load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val = k_val,
      q_vals = q_range,
      cache_dir = "output/fpdc_cache"
    )
    
    if (is.null(fpdc_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing FPDC cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # ----------------------------
    # Extract labels
    # ----------------------------
    pd_labels <- pd_cached$labels
    fpdc_labels <- fpdc_cached$model$label
    
    if (length(pd_labels) != length(fpdc_labels)) {
      cat("    Label length mismatch for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # ----------------------------
    # Compute ARI
    # ----------------------------
    ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(pd_labels, fpdc_labels)
    
    ari_results[[length(ari_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      embedding = embedding_tag,
      k = k_val,
      fpdc_best_q = fpdc_cached$q,
      pd_silhouette = pd_cached$avg_silhouette,
      pd_ch = pd_cached$ch,
      pd_prob_silh = pd_cached$prob_silh,
      fpdc_silhouette = fpdc_cached$silhouette,
      fpdc_ch = fpdc_cached$ch,
      fpdc_prob_silh = fpdc_cached$prob_silh,
      ari = ari_val,
      pd_cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(table(pd_labels)), collapse = "|"),
      fpdc_cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(table(fpdc_labels)), collapse = "|"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r final}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ari_results_df <- bind_rows(ari_results) %>%
  arrange(embedding, k)

print(ari_results_df)

write.csv(
  ari_results_df,
  file = file.path("output/pd_fpdc_ari_results", "ari_pd_vs_fpdc_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r pd-fpdc-contingency-table}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# -------------------------------
embedding_tag <- "user_embeddings_128"   # change as needed
k_val <- 3                               # change as needed
q_range <- 2:4

# -------------------------------
# HELPERS
# -------------------------------

load_pd_labels <- function(embedding_tag, k_val) {
  file <- file.path("output/pd_cache",
                    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) stop("Missing PD cache")
  readRDS(file)$labels
}

load_best_fpdc_labels <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:4) {
  candidates <- list()
  
  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    file <- file.path("output/fpdc_cache",
                      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds"))
    
    if (file.exists(file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(file)
      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        q = q_val,
        sil = cached$Silhouette,
        ch = cached$CH,
        labels = cached$model$label
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(candidates) == 0) stop("No FPDC cache found")
  
  df <- bind_rows(lapply(candidates, function(x) {
    data.frame(q = x$q, Silhouette = x$sil, CH = x$ch)
  }))
  
  best_idx <- with(df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
  candidates[[best_idx]]$labels
}

# -------------------------------
# LOAD LABELS
# -------------------------------
pd_labels <- load_pd_labels(embedding_tag, k_val)
fpdc_labels <- load_best_fpdc_labels(embedding_tag, k_val, q_range)

# -------------------------------
# BUILD CONTINGENCY TABLE
# -------------------------------
cont_table <- table(
  PD = factor(pd_labels),
  FPDC = factor(fpdc_labels)
)

# -------------------------------
# PRINT TABLE
# -------------------------------
cont_table
```
